testcase.name: [It] [sig-network] DNS should support configurable pod resolv.conf
[It] [sig-network] DNS should work with a search path containing an underscore and a search path with a single dot
[It] [sig-network] DNS should work with a service name that starts with a digit [FeatureGate:RelaxedServiceNameValidation]
[It] [sig-network] DNS should work with the pod containing more than 6 DNS search paths and longer than 256 search list characters
[It] [sig-network] DefaultIngressClass should choose the one with the later CreationTimestamp, if equal the one with the lower name when two ingressClasses are marked as default [Serial]
[It] [sig-network] DefaultIngressClass should not set default value if no default IngressClass [Serial]
[It] [sig-network] DefaultIngressClass should set default value on new IngressClass [Serial]
[It] [sig-network] EndpointSlice should create Endpoints and EndpointSlices for Pods matching a Service [Conformance]
[It] [sig-network] EndpointSlice should create and delete EndpointSlices for a Service with a selector that matches no pods [Conformance]
[It] [sig-network] EndpointSlice should support a Service with multiple endpoint IPs specified in multiple EndpointSlices [Conformance]

testcase.name: [It] [sig-network] Services should be able to up and down services

[It] [sig-network] Services should be rejected for evicted pods (no endpoints exist)
[It] [sig-network] Services should be rejected when no endpoints exist
[It] [sig-network] Services should be updated after adding or deleting ports
[It] [sig-network] Services should check NodePort out-of-range
[It] [sig-network] Services should complete a service status lifecycle [Conformance]
[It] [sig-network] Services should connect to the named ports exposed by restartable init containers
[It] [sig-network] Services should connect to the ports exposed by restartable init containers
[It] [sig-network] Services should create endpoints for unready pods
[It] [sig-network] Services should delete a collection of services [Conformance]
[It] [sig-network] Services should fail health check node port if there are only terminating endpoints
[It] [sig-network] Services should fallback to local terminating endpoints when there are no ready endpoints with externalTrafficPolicy=Local
[It] [sig-network] Services should fallback to local terminating endpoints when there are no ready endpoints with internalTrafficPolicy=Local
[It] [sig-network] Services should fallback to terminating endpoints when there are no ready endpoints with externallTrafficPolicy=Cluster
[It] [sig-network] Services should fallback to terminating endpoints when there are no ready endpoints with internalTrafficPolicy=Cluster
[It] [sig-network] Services should find a service from listing all namespaces [Conformance]
[It] [sig-network] Services should have session affinity timeout work for NodePort service [LinuxOnly]
